title: An answer the server computed before the viewer's read, arriving after it, does not bring the read unread back
why: The row keeps the highest seq the viewer read (readSeq). Live 101 is read through 101; an answer at 101 still counting 101 as unread (and its @) was computed before the read reached the server. Every message it counted is at or below the read, so none of it is unread. Without the read seq a client with no store-level correction (the app) shows the unread again until the next answer (Lagoon, Scout, #triage:#244).

web: packages/web/src/store/inboxReadProjection.ts (projectionCoversActivity: web's store meets it today outside the shared rule)
